subject: Insurance
title: Model Risk: When Models Fail
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Model Risk: When Models Fail.

hook.text: Models are only as good as their assumptions. When those assumptions are wrong, the model can be dangerously misleading.

buildup.text: Before Hurricane Katrina, models assumed New Orleans levees would hold. They didn't.

discovery.text: Model risk is the risk that your model is wrong.

twist.text: AIG's financial collapse in 2008 was partly model failure. Their risk models said mortgage defaults wouldn't correlate.

climax.text: Models are essential but fallible. The most dangerous belief in insurance is that the model is always right.

quiz.question: What is model risk?
options: The risk that a predictive model's assumptions are wrong
